profile: A typical university user browsing the Spring 2027 schedule. No known preferences, constraints or role-specific workflows.
rationale: The shared default: a catalog with detail, a schedule, degree progress and seat availability. It serves most students without personalization.

views.title: Course catalog
views.purpose: Find, search, filter or browse the courses and sections offered this term, and read one course's details.

views.title: My schedule
views.purpose: See the week of planned classes, check for time conflicts, and review or submit the enrollment plan.

views.title: Degree progress
views.purpose: Check which degree requirements are complete, planned or remaining, and which courses to take next.

views.title: Seat availability
views.purpose: See which courses are full or waitlisted and how demand compares with capacity.
